clips.send: Hydra (parent). A tiny freshwater animal. Hydra is a small animal related to jellyfish, about 1 cm long. It catches tiny prey with stinging tentacles. When food is plentiful it reproduces asexually by budding. It can also reproduce sexually. Hydra can even regrow lost parts (regeneration), like the monster in the myth.

clips.send: Copied DNA. Each new cell needs a full set of instructions. A bacterium has one loop-shaped (circular) chromosome floating in its cytoplasm. It has no nucleus. Before splitting, it makes an exact copy of the loop. One copy goes to each daughter cell, so both get identical genes. Copy first, then split.

clips.send: Stamen (male part). Makes pollen. Stamen equals anther (makes pollen) + filament (the stalk). Pollen grains carry the plant’s male sex cells (sperm). A flower usually has several stamens around the pistil. STAMEN has “MEN” in it: the male part.

clips.send: Bud. A new organism growing from the parent. Budding: a small outgrowth develops into a new individual and breaks off. The bud has the same genes as the parent, so it is a clone. Yeast (a fungus), some sponges and corals also reproduce by budding. A bud is like a branch that breaks off and lives on its own.

clips.send: Pollen grain. Carries the sperm cells. Pollination: pollen moves from an anther to a stigma, by wind, water or animals like this bee. Here the pollen comes from a different (blue) flower. Cross-pollination mixes genes from two parents. Each pollen grain carries half of the father plant’s chromosomes. Pollination just delivers the pollen. Fertilization comes later.

clips.send: Daughter cells. Identical clones of the parent. The two new cells have the same DNA as the parent cell: they are clones. Each daughter cell can grow and divide again. Rare copying mistakes (mutations) are the main source of variation in bacteria. Clone equals an exact genetic copy.

clips.send: Seed. A baby plant in a protective coat. After fertilization the ovule develops into a seed, and the ovary into a fruit. A seed holds an embryo (tiny plant) and stored food. Its genes are a new mix from both parents: genetic variation. Turn on “Gene colors”: blue pollen + pink egg, purple seed.

clips.send: Binary fission. One cell splits into two. Bacteria reproduce this way. It is a type of asexual reproduction. The cell copies its DNA, grows longer, then pinches in two across the middle. In good conditions, some bacteria such as E. coli can divide about every 20 minutes. Fission equals splitting: 1, 2, 4, 8 …

clips.send: Pistil (female part). Stigma + style + ovary. The sticky stigma at the top catches pollen. The style is the stalk that connects the stigma to the ovary. The ovary holds the ovules. After fertilization the ovary becomes the fruit. Ovary, fruit, ovule, seed.

clips.send: Pollen tube. A tunnel to the egg. After landing on the stigma, the pollen grain grows a tube down through the style. Sperm cells travel down the tube to an ovule. This lets flowering plants reproduce sexually without needing water to swim in. The pollen grain builds its own slide down to the egg.

clips.send: Petal. Attracts pollinators. Bright colors and scent attract bees, butterflies and birds. Pollinators get nectar as food and carry pollen from flower to flower. After fertilization the petals wither and fall off. Petals are advertisements: “Food here!”

clips.send: 花粉粒。携带精子。传粉：花粉从花药转移到柱头上，可以靠风、水或像这只蜜蜂一样的动物。这里的花粉来自另一朵（蓝色的）花。异花传粉让两个亲本的基因混合。每粒花粉只携带父本植物一半的染色体。传粉只是“送货”，受精发生在后面。
clips.text: 花粉粒. 携带精子. 传粉：花粉从花药转移到柱头上，可以靠风、水或像这只蜜蜂一样的动物。. 这里的花粉来自另一朵（蓝色的）花。异花传粉让两个亲本的基因混合。. 每粒花粉只携带父本植物一半的染色体。. 传粉只是“送货”，受精发生在后面。

clips.send: 复制的 DNA。每个新细胞都需要一整套“说明书”。细菌只有一条环状的染色体，漂浮在细胞质中，没有细胞核。分裂之前，它先把这个 DNA 环精确地复制一份。每个子细胞各得到一份，所以它们的基因完全相同。先复制，再分裂。

clips.send: 子细胞。与亲本相同的克隆。两个新细胞的 DNA 和亲本细胞一样：它们是克隆。每个子细胞都能继续生长、再次分裂。偶尔出现的复制错误（突变）是细菌变异的主要来源。克隆 等于 遗传信息完全相同的复制品。

clips.send: 花瓣。吸引传粉者。鲜艳的颜色和香味吸引蜜蜂、蝴蝶和鸟类。传粉者以花蜜为食，同时把花粉从一朵花带到另一朵花。受精后，花瓣会凋谢脱落。花瓣就像广告牌：“这里有好吃的！”

clips.send: 种子。包在种皮里的“植物宝宝”。受精后，胚珠发育成种子，子房发育成果实。种子里有胚（小植物）和储存的养料。它的基因是来自双亲的新组合，这就是遗传变异。打开“基因颜色”：蓝色花粉 + 粉色卵细胞，紫色种子。

clips.send: 雄蕊（雄性部分）。产生花粉。雄蕊 等于 花药（产生花粉）+ 花丝（细长的柄）。花粉粒中含有植物的雄性生殖细胞（精子）。一朵花通常有好几枚雄蕊，围绕在雌蕊周围。雄蕊的“雄” 等于 男性部分。

clips.send: 芽体。从亲本身上长出的新个体。出芽生殖：亲本身上长出的小突起发育成新个体，然后脱落。芽体的基因与亲本相同，所以它是克隆。酵母菌（一种真菌）、某些海绵和珊瑚也进行出芽生殖。芽体就像一根树枝，掉下来后能独立生活。

clips.send: 水螅（亲本）。一种微小的淡水动物。水螅是一种和水母有亲缘关系的小动物，长约 1 厘米。它用带刺细胞的触手捕捉微小的猎物。食物充足时，它通过出芽进行无性生殖；它也能进行有性生殖。水螅还能长回失去的部分（再生），就像神话里的九头蛇。

clips.send: 花粉管。通往卵细胞的“隧道”。花粉落到柱头上后，会长出一根花粉管，穿过花柱向下生长。精子沿着花粉管到达胚珠。这样开花植物不需要水，也能完成有性生殖。花粉粒给自己搭了一条通往卵细胞的“滑梯”。

clips.send: 二分裂。一个细胞分成两个。细菌用这种方式繁殖，它属于无性生殖。细胞先复制 DNA、伸长，然后从中间缢裂成两个。条件适宜时，大肠杆菌等细菌大约每 20 分钟就能分裂一次。分裂 等于 一分为二：1，2，4，8……

clips.send: 雌蕊（雌性部分）。柱头 + 花柱 + 子房。顶端黏黏的柱头能粘住花粉。花柱是连接柱头和子房的细长部分。子房里有胚珠。受精后，子房发育成果实。子房，果实，胚珠，种子。
